How we work

From your order to your door

  1. You order

    Pick a product and checkout. We receive the design file straight away.

  2. We print

    Each piece is printed and quality-checked by hand, usually within two days.

  3. We ship

    Packed plastic-light and sent with tracking. Most orders arrive in a week.

Questions

Before you order

Can I upload my own design?

Yes. Send a PNG or SVG through the contact form and we will confirm a proof first.

How long does delivery take?

Printing takes 1–2 days, shipping 3–5 days.

What if the print is wrong?

Send a photo within 7 days and we reprint it free.
